Variants.Content: Hailing from the Balearic Islands, these specialist skirmishers wore three slings braided from esparto grass and sinew: long-range around the head, mid-range at the waist, and short-range in hand. Firing smooth river stones and cast-lead acorns (glandes), their missiles possessed velocity comparable to arrows, capable of fracturing helmets, shattering shields, and blinding commanders before lines met.
